skill.name: PyTorch
skill.description: Avoid common PyTorch mistakes — train/eval mode, gradient leaks, device mismatches, and checkpoint gotchas.
skill.summary: Train vs Eval Mode - `model.train()` enables dropout, BatchNorm updates — default after init - `model.eval()` disables dropout, uses running stats — MUST call for inference - Mode is sticky — train/eval persists until ex
